kultivator.aura.realm.mortal.name: Mortal Aura
kultivator.aura.realm.mortal.desc: A faint warm glow in the belly swells and dims with the breath, and a few pale motes of qi drift in.
kultivator.aura.realm.mortal.source: Source: A Record of a Mortal's Journey · 长春功 Eternal Spring Art, the wood-attribute foundation art Han Li first practises while still a mortal (the breath and the warmth in the belly are game design)
kultivator.aura.realm.qi_refining.name: Qi Refining Aura
kultivator.aura.realm.qi_refining.desc: The qi of heaven and earth drawn into the body: motes spiral in on curved arms, a pale green-white airflow wraps the body, and a qi vortex turns slowly above the head.
kultivator.aura.realm.qi_refining.source: Source: Battle Through the Heavens, ch. 27 (more and more green airflow wraps Xiao Yan as he trains) and ch. 159 (Xiao Yan's body like a black hole that keeps devouring the energy around it); the vortex above the head is game design
kultivator.aura.realm.foundation.name: Foundation Establishment Aura
kultivator.aura.realm.foundation.desc: The Dao Foundation: an octagonal platform of light under the seat and pillars of light around it, flawless, without a single crack.
kultivator.aura.realm.foundation.source: Source: I Shall Seal the Heavens, ch. 76 and 100 (foundation pillars graded by their cracks; the crackless Perfect Foundation) and A Will Eternal (the Mortal, Earth and Heaven Dao Foundations); the platform of light and the eight-trigram array are game design
kultivator.aura.realm.golden_core.name: Golden Core Aura
kultivator.aura.realm.golden_core.desc: A small sun of golden light shines in the dantian through the body, golden halo rings turn around it, and golden light fills the space like the light of a pill furnace.
kultivator.aura.realm.golden_core.source: Source: I Shall Seal the Heavens, ch. 337-339 (Meng Hao's Perfect Gold Core: golden light fills the cave and liquid gold condenses); 金丹 "golden elixir" in Daoist inner alchemy; the small sun in the dantian and the halo rings are game design
kultivator.aura.realm.nascent_soul.name: Nascent Soul Aura
kultivator.aura.realm.nascent_soul.desc: A small infant with your own face sits cross-legged in meditation on a lotus above your head, with a tiny halo, its faint aura echoing your body's.
kultivator.aura.realm.nascent_soul.sourc: Source: A Record of a Mortal's Journey, ch. 1077 (Han Li's Nascent Soul comes out and circles above his head, an infant with his own face about two and a half inches tall) and ch. 1262 (the Nascent Soul meditating inside his body); the lotus it sits on is game design
kultivator.aura.setting.heading: Cultivation Aura
kultivator.aura.setting.mode.tip: The aura shown while you or your disciples cultivate, different in every realm and growing with every stage. Full: every layer, 3D model, ribbon and particle the Effect Quality allows. Simple: only the decal, glows and particles (light for weak laptops). Off: only the old faint aura.
kultivator.aura.setting.others.tip: Shows the Cultivation Aura of other players and their disciples. Your own aura and your disciples' always show; "Other players' effects" still scales theirs down.
kultivator.aura.setting.hum.tip: A quiet hum that differs per realm and a rare chime from the nearest auras (follows the vanilla Ambient/Environment slider).
